reviews.text:
I highly recommend Petra! She has been incredibly helpful in teaching me practical, effective ways to manage my dog Rosie’s reactivity, nervousness and impulsive puppy behavior. What I appreciated most was how she focuses not only on correcting behaviors, but on helping me understand why Rosie was reacting and how I could communicate with her more effectively.
I’ve learned so many useful techniques for improving her focus, impulse control, and ability to stay calm in situations that previously triggered her. I feel much more confident handling her now, and I’ve already noticed a meaningful difference in her behavior. Petra is patient, kind, knowledgeable, and really takes the time to tailor her approach to the individual dog. I can’t recommend her enough! 🐾

We’ve been so happy with the progress our Klee Kai has made with Petra. She is incredibly knowledgeable, we saw a positive difference after only a few sessions.

We’re very grateful for her guidance and the time she has invested in the training sessions. We would wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking for a trainer.

Petra has been fabulous helping us train our adorable new puppy. We are loving her instruction and our puppy is doing very well and is so much more well-behaved than the last puppy we had where we did not have any training. Petra also helps advise us on puppy behavior and psychology, which are very important and help us understand better why she’s acting the way she does. Petra is engaging intelligent, funny, and most of all has a terrific way with pets. We are very glad we found her and look forward to having her continue to help us make our new puppy the best she can be.
My previous review somehow only messed up on the numbers of stars for Petra.  I cannot say enough great things about her.  Our puppy adores her and we value her help and insights.  Thank you Petra.

Petra has been a great help with raising my little Poppy into a confident, independent girl. Poppy loves Petra so much! She is incredible with dogs and her calming energy always helps both Poppy and me to have a productive training session together. She’s also so knowledgeable on many topics and is always sharing helpful resources on all sorts of things. Highly recommend!
We love working with Petra! She is very diligent and cares a lot about the doggies. Our dog is quite stubborn, and Petra is dedicated to getting her to learn the right behaviors.
Petra is awesome. We have stubborn bassets, resistant to training and they have improved so much with Petra. They love her !

Our doodle pups have made such huge strides with the weekly training Petra has done with them ! Their reactivity to people and other dogs has gone down tremendously. Plus they’re excelling at basic commands.

Petra has been so helpful since we adopted Winnie. Winnie is a sweet pit bull mix, but in the beginning she had leash reactivity to other dogs and pulled constantly - walks were exhausting. Petra helped us understand Winnie better and gave us the tools to manage it.

Within a few months, Winnie completely transformed. She now walks calmly, greets other dogs, and loves joining Petra’s group activities. We can tell how excited Winnie is to see Petra and her new pup friends.

We’re so grateful for the support and highly recommend Petra’s services.
Petra has been super helpful in teaching us all her puppy magic! Seeing great results and behavior improvements already after just a few sessions with her!
Petra is amazing! She’s been helping us so much with our crazy lab puppy. We would be completely lost without her help and advice!

I cannot recommend Petra enough! From day one I have felt so comfortable with Petra and in good hands. We have a difficult cocker spaniel and ever since we started training with Petra, our pup has gotten so much better (as well as our relationship to him!).
Petra always goes above and beyond, answering our questions in detail, even outside of sessions, with patience and care, and is clearly very passionate training dogs. Petra brings decades of experience and I trust everything she says. Petra service feels very white glove and her pricing is very reasonable. I’m very thankful for everything she has done for our pup in the last 6 months, and look forward to her group training sessions!!

I’m so glad Penny’s Pets PDR came up in my search for a reputable and highly recommended dog trainer! Petra has been instrumental in helping my rescue puppy, who spent much of his young life in various shelters, adjust and thrive. Her background in animal behavioral science gives her a remarkable ability to not only guide the dog through training milestones but also share with the owner how to better understand and respond to their pet’s needs.

Petra leads with compassion and helps build a strong, trusting bond between dog and owner. She’s reliable, personable, and her insights are easy to implement — and they truly deliver results. I can’t recommend her highly enough!

Petra has done an amazing job training my rescue pup the last 3 months! She is so genuine and caring, and has so much experience training and helping dogs. She made the process of raising a rescue dog so much more seamless. Gracie loves Petra and her group outings and we’ve learned so much from her individual sessions - everything from leash training to socializing and desensitizing. I could not recommend Petra more (individual training and group days)!

I had a dog before so I thought I knew everything, but when I got a new puppy I was overwhelmed.  Petra gave me lots of tips and great advice for my new baby.  She helped nip the puppy-nipping in the bud before it became a problem.   She taught me how to lovingly but firmly train my pup and get him used to carriers, cars, leashes, etc.
She also brought some other dogs over for puppy play dates and socialization which is so important for puppies.  My puppy is now 6 months old and so happy and well-adjusted.  I would highly recommend Petra to train any dog.
She’s the best!

I have a 6-year old mixed-breed rescued dog, a chunky & aggressive 45 pounder.  When I took him on his twice daily walks, he would charge at anyone who walked by or ran up behind me, causing me to fall a couple of times.  My children were very concerned about my falls and encouraged me to get a trainer to tame my dog.

I found Penny’s Pet Dog Training on Google search and was impressed with owner Petra’s credentials and testimonials from her customers.  In mid-June, I signed up for the initial 10-lessons training.  Petra is always punctual on the scheduled sessions.  Upon returns, she explains what and how she trains and modifies my dog’s undesirable behaviors so that I can do the same to reinforce the training.  She welcomed me to tag along and observed on her walks with my dog.  What I’ve learned is that she has great insights into animal behaviors and infinite patience.  She is teaching my dog as well as me.  My daily walks with my dog are now less stressful as he now doesn’t charge at others as often.  I’ve learned to be more observant of the surroundings during out walks, to anticipate and manage my dog’s reactions to people or animals encountered in passing.  I plan to keep in contact with Petra for further training and/or other services offered by her for dogs.

Petra has been working with our dog and new kitten, to help train them to get along and live peacefully together. They have been making excellent progress. We are so glad to have found Petra and cannot recommend her highly enough - she's so knowledgeable and is great to work with!!!

We have been very satisfied working with Petra over the past few weeks with our new puppy. We also have an older dog, and Petra has provided helpful advice for training the puppy while still allowing the older dog to feel included. Petra provides great flexibility to accommodate our busy schedules, and she tailors each sessions to our current areas of priority. We highly recommend Petra’s services!

Petra is such an amazing trainer! She is warm hearted and very knowledgeable. We’ve only seen her a few times so far to help with our mini Australian Shepherd. He, being a herder, loves taking charge of most situations. In other words, he likes to do what he wants when he wants lol. I am so surprised with just a few visits Petra has been able to tame down our son. She has also identified some of his personality traits that can be worked on so that he can be a more relaxed dog when out and about. She’s given my partner and I tips and tricks at the end of each session to be able to work with our little DaVinci. We can’t wait to see how far he’ll go with her help this year 😊

Petra is a true expert in training dogs, making sure they continue to grow and learn and she provides a great doggy walking group that keeps my dog so happy and socially engaged. We feel so lucky to have found Petra to help guide is in teaching our pet while also loving and caring for him.

I thought it was too late to correct my 7 year old lab’s (strong!) leash pulling. I have tried other group classes, but it never made a difference. After 1-2 sessions with Petra, he had already noticeably improved! We have continued with her for three months now and he only pulls to run and greet her when she arrives❤️ Highly recommend and we will be sticking with Petra for a while
Petra is so amazing, understanding, compassionate. Definitely recommend her

REVISED: We just wanted to add the since writing our initial review in 2021 we've had Petra work with our other dog Lulu. She is also a cattle dog but a bit older. Due to a spinal cord injury she isn't able to play with other dogs very much, and during COVID she interacted with other dogs even less. She would have a very loud meltdown anytime she saw another dog and wasn't allowed to go play with them. Thankfully Petra worked with her over a series of sessions and was able to get her much more comfortable with being in public. Petra has a real gift of dealing with pups with behavioral issues.

From 2021: Petra has been a godsend for our pup Kona. Kona is a rescue and when we first got her she had sever anxiety and a fear of pretty much everything. She's an Australian Cattle dog so she's also smart and very stubborn. She takes a very long time to get used to people but Petra was amazing at approaching her and now she's our dog's favorite person.

We first hired Petra to do 10 sessions of training for Kona. For the first few sessions Petra worked just with Kona, later she had us work with Kona. She brought Kona on a pack walk with other dogs and Kona thrived being part of a pack. Now Petra takes her regularly on these walks and Kona has the best time.

Petra also is our go-to dog sitter for Kona when we need to go out of time. Petra is dependable, timely and very communicative. Plus she sends us cute photos and videos all the time! She also will send us emails about issues that are in our area, food recalls and LA virus outreach like Lepto. She's a wealth of knowledge.

We love Petra and we are sure you will too!

We have had a wonderful experience working with Petra. Our mini golden doodle Milo (1 yo) needed some help with mastering basic commands (sit, stay, come, etc.) Petra has been instrumental in getting him to listen and understand what we are …
Petra is a great dog trainer who cares a lot about our puppy Louis and made a lot of progress training him.
